notes: SOURCE (Revision 4): seemingly endless repetitive hallway with large segmented windows both sides; vibrant pink walls and carpet (carpet slightly darker); windows are solid surfaces of constantly changing static; pitch-black ceiling ~17 m; Pink, the level's consciousness, speaks through any text display (Blair's camera screen, then a laptop with text-to-speech); friendly, eager, sad when wanderers leave; aware of everything inside, sees out only through the exit; a past visitor with a laptop and backpack collapsed after days and Pink used the laptop; GPD drafts as pretty_pink (Revisions 1-3, emails); 'maybe more than a hallway would be nice'; soft static, no buzzing, no monsters; static doors; exit by turning around, always back to origin. Not procedural: the page's hallway is identical everywhere. No second walkable height: the page describes one flat corridor.
